h: Humility and the Power of Living Speech

p: בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ (דְּבָרִים רַבָּה א, ז)
In the Midrash Rabbah on this parshah (Devarim Rabbah 1:7):
To what may this be compared?
To a man who was selling purple wool
and said to him: What are you selling?
He said to him: Nothing, etc.
My master, it is true that it is purple wool,
but in comparison to you it is nothing.
אָמַר לֹא אִישׁ דְּבָרִים אָנֹכִי (שְׁמוֹת ד, י)
said, 'I am not a man of words' (Shemos 4:10);
it is written of him: 'These are the words.'"
The reason he used purple wool in the parable:
the letters alef, reish, gimmel, mem of "argaman"
and the nun alludes to the lower hei,
and over my head, the Shechinah of God."
to the union of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קנה, א)
And this is what it says in the Midrash
וְדַלַּת רֹאשֵׁךְ כָּאַרְגָּמָן (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים ז, ו)
"'And the locks of your head are like purple' (Shir HaShirim 7:6)
are as dear to Me as David,
shall be on that day like David.'"
and David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
is a chariot for the middah of Malchus.
וְהִנֵּה קָשֶׁה לֵיהּ לְהַמִּדְרָשׁ רַבָּה כָּאן
Now the Midrash Rabbah here is troubled by
for it is written "These are the words," etc.,
דְּהָא כְּתִיב אַחַר כָּךְ (דְּבָרִים א, ג)
"And it was in the fortieth year," etc.,
And on this it brings the parable
of one who was selling purple wool, etc.
indicates that it enters the heart;
and according to what is written
and when one has fear of Heaven,
he becomes a chariot for the middah of Malchus,
and then his words are heeded.
on what they said in Shabbos (116a):
"She has hewn out her seven pillars"
and Sefer Devarim, which is the seventh,
corresponds to the middah of Malchus,
Therefore the second Luchos came in it,
which are the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
that there should be in them
And this is what it says,
that he was selling purple wool,
who created the mouth and speech,
he said: "I am not a man of words."
Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
that it was not in his power
in the aspect of the words of Hashem,
that would surely enter the heart,
that goes forth from My mouth:
it shall not return to Me empty,
but it shall accomplish what I desire
and succeed in what I sent it for."
And this is what Moshe said in his humility:
"I am not a man of words."
for he prophesied in the language
"This is the word that Hashem commanded"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב סִפְרֵי מַטּוֹת, סִפְרֵי בְּמִדְבַּר קנג)
(as is written in the Sifrei on Matos, Sifrei Bamidbar 153).
And this is why it says "These are the words":
for this is exactly like the expression
only this is in the plural.
is also a chariot for the Name Havayah,
and his words were literally the word of Hashem:
"My word that goes forth from My mouth."
than what one merits on Shabbos,
that he speak and it be
in the aspect of "the mouth of Hashem,"
as is written in the holy Zohar
when he stood before Hashem Yisbarach
he said, "I am not a man of words,"
as in the parable of the Midrash.
